title: The Protocol of the Kuiper Line
author: August Hartwell
blurb: Wendell Villalobos, the last human technician on an automated relay station, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
